source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Great, thanks for confirming you have the boom arm and softbox.

I’ll send over the shot list and the technical requirements for the tabletop video walkthrough. This will outline the overhead 90° setup, lighting, and the short video walk‑through while the piece is displayed. For the documentation, I need to video the three panels individually, and also the three together while they are displayed on the same black velvet tabletop used for the shoot. ( I have the velvet and table). The clips need to be edited together to produce a single 20-40 sec video. Its straightforward. I'm attaching the shot list document for added detail and clairty.

Let me know if you have questions, and we can discuss.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Added Note: I have a collapsible table that can be used, which can bring the height down to 2 inches off the floor. This will give the flat surface necessary to cover with the black velvet, and plenty of overhead room to comfortably take shots and shoot the video. As long as the boom arm off the tripod locks at 90 degrees it will work well. Ideally the art would be wall mounted for shoot, but since the documentation will take place on tabletop there is the necessity to keep 90 degrees so that the shots are square.

routing_warnings.description: The client approves the video generally but does not specifically verify its 90-degree angle or square framing.
